decisions.reason: The data processing agreement tool sits close to the firm's compliance know-how and its agency customers, and early agency feedback is positive, so in-house R&D lets the firm interpret results and refine it.

The management platform builds directly on the firm's core hosting infrastructure and tooling, is shown on the home page as its strategic focus, and fits the stated expansion of agency platform features.
The configurable managed hosting plan extends the established offer on owned containerized infrastructure, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and adjust it.
